BlazBlue Entropy Effect X - Major Update Trailer - XBOX Series X|S
Platinum joins BlazBlue Entropy Effect X as a new playable character in a major update arriving August 13 on XBOX SERIES X|S

The major update also brings an upgraded Training Space, new branching route options, and more.

Set in the BlazBlue universe, BlazBlue Entropy Effect X is a roguelite action game with striking 2D visuals, stylish fast-paced combat, and precise, responsive controls. Master unique characters from the renowned BlazBlue franchise, shape your build through each run, and discover new ways to fight.
